items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So anyway, as things went on, a young lady, Eva Jessye, was the first to ever teach me--besides my sister--on the piano.

ctx.x: big league baseball player. All through junior high school I was playing good in everything but running. No coach or teacher could teach me to run, I couldn't run.

So anyway, as things went on, a young lady, Eva Jessye, was the first to ever teach me--besides my sister--on the piano. She was one of the teachers, and she was a vocal teacher, and she went on a little later to fame. She left Taft and came to New York and worked and had the Eva Jessye Choir, and now she's known as Dr. Eva Jessye.
